say:4:1221522002:1.text: No worries! I'm just honoring a promise I made as a knight!
say:4:1221522002:1.source_cn: 不用客气，满满是在履行骑士的承诺！

say:5:1221522003:1.text: One day, I might be able to truly move on...
say:5:1221522003:1.source_cn: 也许有天，我可以彻底解开心结……

say:6:1221522004:1.text: Perhaps by then, the god of the waves will have already delivered my letter to Father. He'll know how much Mother longed for his return, and the things I want to say to him...
say:6:1221522004:1.source_cn: 或许那时，风浪与漂泊之神会将漂流瓶送到爸爸身边，他会看...

say:6:1221522004:1.female: Perhaps by then, the god of the waves will have already delivered my letter to Father. He'll know how much Mother longed for his return, and the things I want to say to him...

say:8:1221522005:1.text: The god will hear your wish.
say:8:1221522005:1.source_cn: 神明会听见你的心愿的。

say:9:1221522006:1.source_cn: 没错，满满相信一定会的！

say:10:1221522007:1.text: Thank you, and goodbye. May the god of the waves bless you.
say:10:1221522007:1.source_cn: 谢谢你们，再见了，愿风浪与漂泊之神保佑你们。
